review_text: The battery backup easily crosses 36 hours and the camera zoom capture is insanely detailed.
Screen display is vivid and ultra responsive, but the phone gets quite hot when playing Genshin Impact.
Silent fans under normal web development workload and battery stays strong throughout whole day.
The power brick is huge and heavy. Build quality is nice but price feels exaggerated.
Super light in the ear with deep bass. The noise cancellation creates instant peace in coffee shops.
Mic quality is disappointing when speaking on phone calls in traffic noise. ANC works decently.
GPS locked on instantly during my 10k marathon. Heart rate sensor tracked accurately compared to chest strap.
Sleep tracking registered fake awake periods. Watch build and screen are sturdy nonetheless.
The OLED colors pop so nicely when editing raw photography. Four speakers sound remarkably spacious.
Stylus has great ergonomics but battery charging speed on the tablet is sluggish.
